title: Understanding you
summary: Kumo asks two things it would like you to explain, on its Planning with you track, each with what it already understands, the missing piece and why it would help. They wait quietly in Understanding you: no Desk card, no notification. You say Not now to one. You answer the other with two taps and a line: it's evidence on the track, and Kumo files what it learned in the background, with no follow-up. Kumo settles the one you set aside once you answer it in the chat, and never asks the same thing twice.
